description.value: Easter Seals House is a 49-suite hotel-style facility on Oak Street in Vancouver run by Easter Seals BC/Yukon, located just blocks from major hospitals and treatment centres. It primarily serves adults and families traveling to Vancouver for medical appointments, as well as caregivers seeking respite, in a fully wheelchair-accessible and supportive environment. Suites include kitchenettes, and the building offers underground parking and on-site laundry in a neighbourhood with restaurants and supermarkets within walking distance.

raw_osm.name: Easter Seals House

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Easter Seals House is an active 49-suite medical travel and respite accommodation operated by Easter Seals BC/Yukon at 3981 Oak Street, Vancouver. Amenities explicitly confirmed via website include on-site laundry machines, free Wi-Fi, and underground parking; the Respite Program page explicitly states restaurants and supermarkets are within walking distance. No bike-specific storage, tools, or charging are mentioned anywhere in the website content, and the underground parking is not described in bike-friendly terms.
